goal: Name the single most valuable improvement EXCAVA could make to how it presents results to its owner, and say concretely what to change.

judge.said:
ARTIFACT 1

The winner is more concrete and actionable because it specifies exact UI changes (two-panel layout, one-click fixes) and measurable deliverables (daily/weekly digest emails).
